meta.name: add-teams
meta.description: Add Microsoft Teams channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 它会从 channels 分支把 Teams 适配器复制到 src/channels/，装上依赖并跑构建和注册测试，再用 Teams CLI 创建机器人、把凭据写进 .env，最后把助手接到你指定的 Teams 账号，并主动先给对方发消息。
howto.when: 当你想给助手加上 Microsoft Teams 频道支持（团队频道、群聊、私信）时触发；适配器不在主干里，需要从 channels 分支手动引入。

say.text: 帮我把 Microsoft Teams 频道接入搭好
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑测试

say.text: 用 Teams CLI 创建这个机器人
say.note: 会先登录、注册 Entra 应用和机器人并给出安装链接

say.text: 把助手接到我的 Teams 账号上
say.note: 接通后助手会先给你发一条私信

howto.what_en: Copies the Teams adapter into src/channels/, installs the adapter package, builds and runs its registration test, then uses the Teams CLI to create a bot, save credentials to .env, and wire the assistant to a Teams account.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add Microsoft Teams support (team channels, group chats, DMs) to the assistant; channels aren't shipped in trunk, so the adapter is pulled from the channels branch.

say_en.text: Set up the Microsoft Teams channel integration for me.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, runs build and the registration test.

say_en.text: Create the Teams bot with the Teams CLI.
say_en.note: Signs in, registers the Entra app and bot, and returns an install link.

say_en.text: Wire the assistant to my Teams account.
say_en.note: The assistant messages that account first.
